title: Private Photo Shoot in the Oaks in City Park
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
I will guide you through this stunning part of the City and tell everything I learned and read about its history. You'll have the beautiful plants and old oaks as your background for the shoot, and I'll help you find the right poses to capture your best looks. I will make sure you have great pictures to take home—a unique souvenir of your time in New Orleans.
This is a private experience.

Minimum bookings accepted is 2 people.

I'll send you 15-20 digital photos (per person) or over 100 for group. Within 5 to 10 days after the session.

Additional information:

- If you would like to have non edited photos, please request it before your session.
- If you want to choose photos that we will edit yourself, please request it before the session.
